stories.title: Stitching Training Programme
stories.desc: Started in 2023, this flagship programme supported by HG Infra Engineering Ltd. targets training 1,000 rural women in stitching and tailoring for economic independence.

stories.title: Self Help Groups
stories.desc: Over 500 SHGs formed across villages, enabling women to save, access credit and start micro-enterprises — transforming household economies.

stories.title: Health & Nutrition Camps
stories.desc: Regular community health camps providing maternal care, nutrition counselling and basic health services to underserved rural populations.
